item.title: The AI data centre boom is remaking US factory supply chains, and Trump’s tariffs are the wildcard
item.summary: Generac built its business on backyard generators. Now it is spending $250 million by the end of next year retooling multiple factories to build heavy-duty versions for data centres. The post The AI data centre boom is remaking US factory supply chains, and Trump’s tariffs are the wildcard appeared first on Capacity .
